title: Throughline Backlog Contract (nested: epics group stories)
description: Single source of truth for work. Epics are vertically-sliced shippable increments grouping user stories. Stories are the LEAF records that carry status; epic progress is DERIVED, never stored. The backlog IS the tracker; an external tracker is an optional mirror.

repo.description: Repo base URL for deep-linking issues (only when a remote tracker is used).

tracker.description: Optional issue-tracker mirror. Default 'local' = offline, no account: stories are the work items, status set by the skills, dashboard links to PRD/backlog. GitHub mirrors via the sync adapter.

release_in_flight.description: Names the release currently being worked (e.g. 'v1', 'v2'). Written by define-backlog, in the same write as the first epic tagged to the new release (never by define-product — that would let this field point at a release with no matching epic yet while define-architecture/define-design run validate.mjs in between). Read by measure-learn (names the retro file) and the next define-brief (resolves which retro to check). Freeform, matches epics[].release.

health.description: Optional schedule verdict shown on the dashboard (behind/ahead needs a schedule, so it is set, not derived).

prd.description: Path to the PRD that REQ ids resolve against.

coverage.description: Optional code-coverage gate. Absence of this key means no enforcement (backward-compatible with installs that predate this feature).

min.description: Minimum aggregate line coverage required when mode is 'enforce'.

mode.description: off = ignored; warn = measured and reported, never blocks; enforce = blocks done stories/ship-epic/CI below min.

command.description: Override: exact command to run instead of stack auto-detection.

stacks.description: Override: restrict detection to these stack ids (e.g. for a monorepo).

target_date.description: Optional target completion date YYYY-MM-DD; drives overdue detection.

gh_issue.description: Tracker issue number; only with a remote tracker.

epic.description: REQUIRED. The epic this story belongs to.

status.description: Owned by the status adapter (sync-status with a tracker, or the skills in local mode). Never hand-edit casually.

blocked_by.description: Story ids this depends on. Absence means no known dependencies.

design_ref.description: Optional path to the docs/design/screens/*.md this story implements (e.g. docs/design/screens/S-08-flight-form.md). One screen per story — a story needing several is a signal to split it. Set by define-backlog when a screen doc exists; read by define-epic into the story's acceptance criteria.
